subject: general
question: A and B working together can do a piece of work in 6 days. B alone can do the same work in 14 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do double the work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time taken by A alone for single work = (Product of Days) ÷ (Difference of Days)

Time for A = (14 × 6) ÷ (14 − 6) = 84 ÷ 8 = 10.5 days

For double the work, time required = 10.5 × 2 = 21 days

**∴ The correct answer is 21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Time taken by (A + B) = 6 days

Time taken by B = 14 days

Formula used: Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken
